clauses.text: Inheritance, basis layer and version, and judgment kind are optional; proofs without them validate exactly as before.
Validation rejects inheritance sources with prior_learning_reused=false, unknown basis layers, and malformed judgment kinds.
The completion receipt labels layered basis entries and shows an inheritance line only when inheritance sources exist; receipts for proofs without the new fields are unchanged.
The review card shows an inheritance row that reads as unrecorded when no inheritance was recorded, and never invents one.
The public JSON schema contract declares the same optional fields.
